description: This file defines the implementation of display information and properties for a platform-specific module, including handling HDMI connection status, EDID reading, GPU memory querying, and HDCP protection levels; it adheres to multiple interfaces for display, connection, graphics, HDR, and configuration properties.

classes.name: DisplayInfoImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing various display and connection interfaces, managing HDMI state, EDID data, GPU memory, and HDCP protection levels, and providing property accessors and notifications.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the display info implementation based on the framework's configuration line.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for connection state changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification sink.

methods.name: IsAudioPassthrough
methods.description: Checks if audio passthrough is enabled.

methods.name: Connected
methods.description: Checks if the display is connected.

methods.name: HDCPProtection
methods.description: Gets or sets HDCP protection level.

methods.name: EDID
methods.description: Gets the Extended Display Identification Data (EDID).

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Updates the display state and notifies observers.

methods.name: RetrieveEDID
methods.description: Reads EDID segments from the display via DDC.
